decision_principle: The naive_full method is intentionally misspecified because it omits the sequencing variable. Its loss of coverage under strong sequencing is a target simulation result, not a validity failure. Confirmatory readiness is therefore gated on numerical success and included-variable balance for the naive comparator, plus predeclared mechanism checks. Bias and coverage validity gates apply only to adjusted_full and sequencing_aware.
boundary: No simulation is rerun and no Stage 33 or Stage 33B output is changed. This amendment documents a design-gate error discovered after restoration of the true-null summaries: coverage was incorrectly required for an intentionally misspecified diagnostic comparator. The amended rule is locked before the independent confirmatory simulation.
